items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: This was during the time Lindburgh's baby was kidnaped.

ctx.x: Hey, these names are sort of coming back to me now. And, gee, who was -- oh, I'll think of some of these -- some of the other names. But, anyway, I started -- then, this is when I started the really try to write, because we had no music. And, I had -- I was making like one or two arrangements a day, and we'd come in and rehearse it. Because we had to go on the air. This was during the time Lindburgh's baby was kidnaped.
